skill_name: Write a persuasive essay about why the voting age should be lowered.
workflow: Lowering the voting age is an important step towards a better, more representative democracy. Young people, who make up a significant portion of the population, should have a say in their future and receive the same rights and benefits as adults. The young generation is very informed and conscious of the world’s current state, and is more likely to remain aware of their political environment as they age.
